sources.title: RF-DETR — Real-Time Object Detection & Segmentation by Roboflow
sources.snippet: RF-DETR (Roboflow Detection Transformer) is a real-time object detection and instance segmentation model from Roboflow, accepted at ICLR 2026. It uses a DINOv2 vision transformer backbone and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy-latency trade-offs on COCO (60.1 AP50:95 for RF-DETR-2XL) and RF100-VL. How does RF-DETR compare to YOLOv11?
